definitions.gloss: first-come; arriving first; in order of arrival
definitions.explanation: refers to a system where priority is given based on order of arrival; commonly used for limited offers or events

examples.japanese: {先着|せんちゃく}{五十名様|ごじゅうめいさま}にプレゼント。
{先着|せんちゃく}{順|じゅん}で{受|う}け{付|つ}けます。
examples.english: We will accept applications on a first-come, first-served basis.

examples.japanese: {先着|せんちゃく}{百名|ひゃくめい}{限定|げんてい}の{特別|とくべつ}セールが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: A special sale limited to the first 100 customers has begun.

notes:
FORMS:
{先|せん} (first, ahead) + {着|ちゃく} (arriving) → arriving first

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {先着|せんちゃく}{順|じゅん} (in order of arrival)
- {先着|せんちゃく}〜{名|めい}/{名様|めいさま} (first ~ people)
- {先着|せんちゃく}{限定|げんてい} (limited to first arrivals)
- {先着|せんちゃく}{特典|とくてん} (first-come bonus)

USAGE:
Commonly seen in:
- Promotional campaigns ({先着|せんちゃく}○{名|めい}にプレゼント)
- Event registrations
- Limited sales
- Restaurant seating

RELATED WORDS:
- {早|はや}い{者|もの}{勝|が}ち (first come, first served - more casual)
- {抽選|ちゅうせん} (lottery - alternative allocation method)
- {予約|よやく}{優先|ゆうせん} (reservation priority)
